title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Pegozafermin in Participants With Compensated Cirrhosis Due to MASH
official: A Phase 3 Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Pegozafermin in Subjects With Compensated Cirrhosis Due to Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH) (ENLIGHTEN-Cirrhosis)
summary: The study will assess the efficacy and safety of pegozafermin administered in participants with biopsy-confirmed and clinically confirmed compensated cirrhosis due to MASH .
conditions: Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH) / Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) With Compensated Cirrhosis
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Males or non-pregnant females aged between 18 and 75 years (inclusive) at time of signing the informed consent form (ICF).
* Participants must have type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosed at least 3 months before screening or at least 2 metabolic risk factors.
* Evidence of both cirrhosis and MASH etiology, either through a historical biopsy or a biopsy at Screening.
* Clinical diagnosis of cirrhosis based on the NIT algorithm.

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Liver disorder other than MASH.
* History or evidence of hepatic decompensation.
* History or evidence of hepatocellular carcinoma.
* Have type 1 diabetes mellitus or poorly controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus.
* ALT or aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≥250 units per liter (U/L).
* Participants taking vitamin E (\>400 international units \[IU\]/day) must be on stable dose for at least 6 months prior to screening.

Other protocol-defined inclusion and exclusion criteria may apply.
